title: Tasting Event at Acquilano Wine Cellars
description: Join us for an afternoon tasting at Acquilano Wine Cellars. Will Jenkins will be on hand pouring our 2024 Vignoles and 2024 Dry Rosé — come taste the first vintage and say hello.

title: Prose & Rosé Fest
description: A Book Fair & Rosé Festival celebrating stories, sips, and community. Find us pouring at Bonesteel Wines in Victor for a day of local authors, outdoor browsing, and great wine.
